independence.subtitle: The claim is small, but every resource you recover now belongs to you.
independence.instruction: This ore is yours. Break deposits, build a personal stockpile, and sell it directly for full value.

ui.title: Blackstone Breakaway
ui.subtitle: Every ton belongs to Blackstone. Every dollar toward freedom belongs to you.
ui.instruction: Keep swinging. Blackstone owns the ore; you receive a small wage when the deposit breaks.

skillBranches.name: Miner
skillBranches.description: Build personal strength, swing efficiency, and critical impact.

skillBranches.name: Prospector
skillBranches.description: Improve ore recovery, rare discoveries, and experience earned underground.

skillBranches.name: Business
skillBranches.description: Improve company output and turn an automated operation into character experience.

skills.name: Mining Power
skills.description: Deal more damage to every deposit with each manual swing.

skills.name: Mining Speed
skills.description: A practiced rhythm increases the useful force delivered by every manual swing.

skills.name: Critical Chance
skills.description: Adds a chance for a manual swing to deal critical mining damage.

skills.name: Critical Damage
skills.description: Makes every critical mining hit strike harder.

skills.name: Ore Yield
skills.description: Adds a chance to recover one bonus resource when a deposit breaks.

skills.name: Rare Find Chance
skills.description: Improves the chance that a manual deposit break uncovers a valuable rare find.

skills.name: Field Experience
skills.description: Reading each broken face turns manual mining into faster character growth.

skills.name: Rich Deposits
skills.description: Advanced prospecting recovers more usable material from every personal deposit.

skills.name: Automation Bonus
skills.description: Improves workers and company machinery without replacing your manual miner.

skills.name: Crew Education
skills.description: Structured shift reports let your workers pass practical mining knowledge back to you.

skills.description: Coordinated hauling and maintenance multiply every assigned operation.

items.name: Steel Pickaxe

items.name: Hardened Pickaxe
items.description: Heat-treated steel built for long shifts and stubborn rock.

items.name: Diamond-Tipped Pickaxe
items.description: An expensive precision head that turns personal swings into serious production.

items.name: Leather Work Gloves
items.description: A steadier grip creates more opportunities for a perfect strike.

items.name: Impact Gloves
items.description: Reinforced palms transfer more force when a critical swing lands.

items.name: Surveyor's Lamp
items.description: A focused beam helps distinguish usable ore from waste rock.

items.name: Prospector Helmet
items.description: A rugged helmet with a calibrated lamp for spotting rich fragments.

items.name: Powered Pickaxe
items.description: A compact powered head multiplies the force of a practiced miner.

items.name: Pneumatic Drill
items.description: A professional air drill turns personal mining into industrial work.

items.name: Precision Grip Gloves
items.description: Tactile reinforcement helps line up critical fractures.

items.name: Anti-Vibration Gloves
items.description: Industrial damping keeps full force behind the hardest critical swings.

items.name: Deep-Shaft Lamp
items.description: A high-output lamp exposes unusual seams in deep workings.

items.name: Geological Scanner Helmet

items.name: Leather Work Boots
items.description: Reliable footing helps maintain a steady mining rhythm.

items.name: Reinforced Mining Boots
items.description: Steel reinforcement creates a more stable base for hard swings.

items.name: Shock-Absorbing Boots
items.description: Cushioned industrial soles keep repeated swings efficient.

items.name: Expedition Boots
items.description: Premium deep-mine boots provide maximum stability on broken ground.

items.name: Canvas Ore Bag
items.description: Separate sample pockets prevent useful fragments from being discarded.

items.name: Prospector Pack
items.description: Organized sample storage improves usable ore recovery.

items.name: Reinforced Sample Pack
items.description: Protected compartments preserve more material from every personal deposit.

items.name: Mobile Field Lab Pack
items.description: On-site analysis turns each deposit into a better learning opportunity.

lottery.disclaimer: A completely fictional game of chance purchased only with earned in-game cash. Prizes have no real-world value.

scratchTickets.name: Coal Dust Dollar
scratchTickets.description: An entry-level ticket with small prizes and one unlikely hundred-dollar strike.

scratchTickets.name: Gold Vein Scratch-Off
scratchTickets.description: A familiar ten-dollar ticket with a rare one-thousand-dollar jackpot.

scratchTickets.name: Silver Strike Scratch-Off
scratchTickets.description: A level-six ticket with a rare ten-thousand-dollar top prize.

scratchTickets.name: Mother Lode Scratch-Off

scratchTickets.name: Diamond Drill Scratch-Off
scratchTickets.description: A high-level ticket with a one-million-dollar jackpot hidden beneath the dust.

scratchTickets.name: Tycoon Claim Scratch-Off

scratchTickets.name: Blackstone Crown Scratch-Off

store.name: Miller's General Store
store.description: A familiar supply counter for working miners, independent operators, and anyone feeling lucky.

categories.name: Mining Tools
categories.description: Personal tools that directly increase manual mining power.

categories.name: Gloves & Lamps
categories.description: Gear for critical strikes and better ore recovery.

categories.name: Boots & Ore Packs
categories.description: Level-gated gear for stronger footing, better recovery, and more field experience.

categories.name: Lottery Counter

rival.name: Blackstone Mining Co.
rival.description: Blackstone remains the region's established operator. Its notices mark your rise from dismissed former employee to serious competitor.

milestones.title: Blackstone Expands
milestones.speaker: Regional Mining Bulletin
milestones.text: Blackstone Mining opened another shaft. Foreman Cole calls your new company a temporary distraction.

milestones.title: A Major Ore Contract
milestones.speaker: Regional Mining Bulletin
milestones.text: Blackstone secured a major ore contract, but buyers have started asking whether your operation can provide a second supply line.

milestones.title: Blackstone Has Noticed
milestones.speaker: Foreman Cole
milestones.text: Three productive mines? You have Blackstone's attention now. Do not mistake attention for respect.

milestones.title: An Offer From Blackstone
milestones.speaker: Blackstone Executive Office
milestones.text: Blackstone Mining has offered to purchase your company. The offer is profitable, final, and declined on your behalf.

milestones.title: The Region's Largest Producer
milestones.speaker: Regional Mining Bulletin
milestones.text: Your company has surpassed Blackstone's production rate. The company that once owned every rock you broke is now the smaller operation.

acquisition.title: Acquire Blackstone Mining Co.
acquisition.description: Purchase your former employer only after your company has the scale, production, mining history, and industry reputation to absorb it.

completion.title: The Company Is Yours
completion.speaker: Foreman Cole
completion.text: Blackstone Mining Co. now belongs to you. The shaft where you started is one operation in your company, and this acquisition is only the beginning.

generators.name: Hired Miner
generators.description: A dependable miner assigned to a separate company worksite.

generators.name: Mining Crew
generators.description: A coordinated four-person team assigned to its own company deposit.

generators.name: Mechanical Drill
generators.description: A powered drill assigned to an industrial worksite separate from personal mining.

businessUpgrades.name: Worker Training
businessUpgrades.description: Safer technique and cleaner handoffs improve every automated operation.

businessUpgrades.name: Employee Development Program
businessUpgrades.description: Purchase structured reports and instruction so an automated operation continues advancing your character.

businessUpgrades.name: Better Carts
businessUpgrades.description: Improved hauling keeps mining crews working instead of waiting on ore removal.

businessUpgrades.name: Improved Drills
businessUpgrades.description: Stronger bits and better cooling increase mechanical drill output.

milestones.title: First Shift
milestones.speaker: Foreman Cole
milestones.text: Keep swinging. There are twenty men waiting for your job.

milestones.title: A Stronger Swing
milestones.speaker: Foreman Cole
milestones.text: Getting faster, are you? Blackstone still owns every rock you break.

milestones.title: Management Has Noticed
milestones.speaker: Blackstone Notice
milestones.text: Your shift output is above target. Your wage rate remains unchanged.

milestones.title: Freedom Is Affordable
milestones.speaker: Contract Office
milestones.text: You now have enough cash to buy out your employment contract.

milestones.title: Independent Miner
milestones.speaker: Foreman Cole
milestones.text: You'll be back when that little claim dries up.

milestones.title: A Company of Your Own
milestones.speaker: County Clerk
milestones.text: The registration is official. Your claim is now a mining company, and your first hires can begin work.

mines.name: Blackstone Shaft 7
mines.description: A cramped company shaft where new hires prove they can keep pace.

mines.name: Abandoned Quarry
mines.description: Your first independent ground is shallow, weathered, and finally yours to work.

mines.name: Copper Ridge Claim
mines.description: A rust-colored ridge with reliable copper seams and the first traces of workable iron.

mines.name: Old Iron Mine
mines.description: A neglected hillside claim with dependable iron beneath its weathered timber supports.

mines.name: Silver Run Mine
mines.description: Cool gray rock carries richer silver bands and enough gold to change the scale of the business.

mines.name: Deep Shaft
mines.description: Reinforced lifts descend to silver-bearing rock and the first serious traces of gold.

mines.name: Golden Basin
mines.description: A broad underground basin carries heavy gold and the first commercial emerald pockets.

mines.name: Crystal Caverns
mines.description: Natural chambers conceal gold, emeralds, and rare ruby pockets behind dense stone.

mines.name: Ruby Fault
mines.description: A pressurized fault line holds bright ruby pockets and occasional diamond-bearing fractures.

mines.name: Ancient Depths
mines.description: The deepest surveyed workings demand a regional company and reward it with exceptional gemstones.

finds.name: Ancient Coin
finds.description: A worn collector's coin was wedged behind the broken face.

finds.name: Fossil Impression
finds.description: A clean fossil impression teaches you more about reading the surrounding rock.

finds.name: Rich Copper Cache
finds.description: A compact pocket of high-grade copper survived inside the deposit.

finds.name: Silver Specimen
finds.description: An unusually pure silver specimen can be sold intact.

finds.name: Hidden Gem Pocket
finds.description: A narrow seam opens onto a single saleable emerald.

finds.name: Lost Payroll Box
finds.description: A rusted lockbox still contains old company scrip accepted by a collector.

events.name: Rich Seam
events.description: Fresh fractures expose denser material. Deposit rewards are improved while the seam holds.

events.name: Gold Rush
events.description: Gold-bearing deposits become much more likely and all recovered material is richer.

events.name: Gemstone Flash
events.description: A sparkling fracture reveals a short-lived run of richer gemstone deposits.
